lastCompletedStory.title: Wire validate-agents-md as check:all gate #12 and update gate-count freezes

openQuestions: Resolved from US-001/US-002 carry-over: the KNOWN_MISSING allowlist in scripts/validate-agents-md.ts now carries 18 new entries (bare-filename shorthand for scripts/cam/{prd,handoff,worker-report,review-report,handoff.schema}.json, journal.md, patterns.md, lessons.md, memory/, run.ts, setup.ts, orch-agent-allowlist.sh, .cam-orch-handoff{,.consumed}.json, scripts/cam/issues/CAM-XXXX.json, foo.json, postgres.js, frontend.tsx) so `bun run check:agents` / gate #12 is green against the live repo. Also fixed a genuine doc-staleness bug: removed the nonexistent `.githooks/**` token from subagent-implementer.md's Constraints list (redundant with the already-present `.claude/hooks/**`).

The 4 pre-existing KNOWN_MISSING 'matched nothing this run' warnings (.claude/.cam-orch-ready, scripts/cam/prd.json, scripts/cam/journal.archive.md, /exit) are non-fatal by design (dead-allowlist-entry guard, does not fail the gate) and predate this story (US-001). Not fixed; follow-up candidate if someone wants a zero-warning run.
nextStoryContext: US-003 is done: check-all.ts's GATES manifest now has 12 entries ending in agents-md (bun scripts/validate-agents-md.ts), package.json has a check:agents alias, and both gate-count freezes (test/gates-manifest.test.ts, test/check-all.test.ts) assert 12. check:ci-parity stayed green with no BUN_RUN_ALLOWLIST change needed (check:agents is never invoked directly in ci.yml; check:all is the CI spine and covers it). scripts/file-size-budget.json ceilings raised for scripts/check-all.ts (173->174) and test/check-all.test.ts (383->391) with a dated _ref entry. Full bun run check:all is green end-to-end (all 12 gates, exit 0).
